integrity: The proof is exact. The floating-point entropy value in the verifier is diagnostic only; the strict violation follows from integer and rational inequalities.
limitations: The counterexample concerns the unrooted three-qubit entropy product only.
It does not refute the geometric-mean MEMS quantities introduced in the same work.
It establishes failure of average LOCC monotonicity for one explicit pure-state instrument, not a classification of all failures.
title: The unrooted three-qubit entropy product fails average LOCC monotonicity
